{{Infobox auto}}
A '''frog''' is a [[fishing junk]] item caught in Swamp and Mangrove Swamp. It is a renamed {{MCW|Frog Spawn Egg|frog spawn egg}} that doesn't stack.

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
The junk table lists it at 5 of 93 junk weight in swamps: 5.38% of junk, about 0.54% of all catches in open water.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref> It plays the frog [[fishing sounds|catch sound]].

== Usage ==
Placing it spawns a frog. Using it on a [[spawner]] outside Creative mode destroys every spawner and trial spawner within 16 blocks and deals 1 damage to the player.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/no_egg_on_spawner.mcfunction}}</ref>
